description: This file declares the CloudStoreImplementation class, which implements the IStore2 and IConfiguration interfaces for the WPEFramework plugin. It provides methods for configuration, registration, value management, and namespace operations related to cloud storage.

classes.name: CloudStoreImplementation
classes.description: A class implementing cloud storage and configuration interfaces for the plugin, managing notifications and key-value storage operations.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the plugin with the provided shell service.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback with the account store.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification callback from the account store.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the account store within a specified namespace and TTL.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value and TTL for a given key in the account store within a specified namespace.

methods.name: DeleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a key from the account store within a specified namespace.

methods.name: DeleteNamespace
methods.description: Deletes an entire namespace from the account store.
